about: Routing evaluation cases. Labels are the owner's acceptable ranges, not ground truth. Tiers: light (Luna, Haiku) < practical (Sonnet, Terra) < top (Sol, Opus) < exceptional (Astra). Cases in the held-out split must never be used to edit routing guidance; once one has influenced the guidance, move it to dev. Groups are counterfactual sets: same intent phrased differently, same vocabulary at different difficulty, or same request under different allowance.
